name: Hoisin Pork Stir-Fry with Soba Noodles, Broccoli, Celery & Ginger
instructions: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, add noodles and cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water; set aside.
While the noodles are cooking, peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise; add to the bowl with the ginger.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into ½-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, pork, garlic powder, and salt; stir-fry until the meat is browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.

Add broccoli, hoisin sauce, and water to the skillet; stir to combine and cover with a lid. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is tender and sauce is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide noodles, stir-fry, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
